headline: 6 items require your attention today.
1. Project Phoenix at risk: dependency delayed
2. Payments Migration: discussed repeatedly without a decision
3. Unowned escalation: Northwind data sync failures
You have 3 meetings today. 2 require preparation.

attention.label: Risk detected
attention.title: Project Phoenix at risk: dependency delayed
attention.why: Decision D-1001 (“Launch Project Phoenix on October 21”) was made in Product Leadership Meeting on Oct 6. Marcus Chen committed: “Engineering will complete Phoenix performance testing by October 11” (due Oct 11) — first stated in Microsoft Teams on Oct 6, confirmed in Outlook on Oct 7. It depends on the platform team's API release, which is now reported delayed — Slack #platform (Oct 9): “Heads up: the API release for Phoenix is delayed.”; Jira (Oct 9): “Status changed In Progress → Blocked.”.

recommended_action.text: Ask Marcus for a recovery plan that protects D-1001 (Launch Project Phoenix on October 21) and a confirmed date for the platform team's API release. ROOK can draft the follow-up for your approval.

attention.label: Risk detected
attention.title: Payments Migration: discussed repeatedly without a decision
attention.why: Payments Migration has been discussed in 4 meetings over 2 weeks (Sep 19, Sep 26, Sep 30, Oct 4) without a recorded decision. Open items keep recurring in each transcript.

recommended_action.text: Time-box the Payments Migration decision in Payments Migration steering (Oct 10): name a decision owner and a deadline, and list what information is still missing.
